method: Independent LLM auditors compared the raw PDF text of each sampled course block with the parsed record, field by field (ok / minor = cosmetic / wrong). Each round used a new random sample stratified by academic year and department; fixes made after rounds 1 and 2 were general (footer removal, section headings, unit numbering), not per-record.
